BiblicalUsage: Rechabiah was the son of Eliezer, the son of Moses, and his sons were many. His line served among the Levites in the courses of the priests and in the treasuries of the house of God.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the Levite lines are kept so that the house of God is never left without servants.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
